## Reliable context alongside large saved evidence

Unrelated large test logs could block prompt context and scoped provider reviews before the model
started. Working-copy identity capture now streams exact hashes independently of source-body
delivery limits, including repositories before their first commit. Existing source, symlink and
concurrent-edit checks remain active.

Automatic retrieval follows the saved-evidence convention already used by documentation checks.
Raw logs and snapshots under `docs/**/evidence/**` stay outside the automatic classifier inventory;
authored README and index summaries remain eligible. Required guidance, declared task sources and
explicit bounded original access retain their existing rules. Artifact bytes and the validation
inventory remain intact.

The installed first-task suite now includes a generated artifact larger than the normal content
read limit. JEV stays optional, the coding model stays fixed, and adopter upgrades remain deliberate.
